text:
Maria (Finance): Heads up — saw a -$12,045 line on the March AWS Marketplace settlement labeled `Free tier credits`. Doesn't match our usage in the AWS Marketplace portal. Anyone aware of a promo or reseller override? Invoice PDF attached in the thread.
billing-bot: Automated invoice posted: Invoice ID INV-2027-03-7890 · total $98,765 · adjustments: -$12,045 (free_tier_credit). More details: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/checkout/invoices/INV-2027-03-7890
Arjun (Billing Ops): @Maria I dug in — portal shows no promo grants on our partner account. That adjustment looks like an AWS-applied free-tier offset tied to the merchant/account mapping. Can you paste the invoice CSV lines?
Maria (Finance): Sure — here's the relevant snippet from the invoice (CSV):
```
invoice_line_id,description,amount,currency
L-00123,Compute usage,110000,USD
L-00124,Marketplace fees,-12045,USD  # line shows as free_tier_credit
L-00125,Support,2810,USD
```
Jenna (Accountant): That offset is odd — if it's applied to `redwood-marketplace-reseller` it should have been recorded on partner billing. @Sam can you check partner account mapping? Also need to hold revenue recognition until this is clarified.
Sam (Cloud Partnerships): On it. Just pinged our partner AM + AWS account rep. Quick question: our reseller contract was set to "partner absorbs promo credits" or "AWS passes credits through to vendor"? I can't recall the clause.
Tomas (Sales Ops): Contract says partner absorbs promotional credits up to $5k/quarter. This adjustment is >$12k so looks like AWS applied credits directly to our invoice instead of charging partner. Filing an AWS support case now.
Arjun (Billing Ops): Case opened: AWS Support 1234567890. Message sent: "Please investigate unexpected 'free_tier_credit' -$12,045 on invoice INV-2027-03-7890. We believe merchant-account mapping may be incorrect; request reversal or explanation and corrected invoice. Attached reconciliation spreadsheet."
Maria (Finance): Uploaded reconciliation to our drive: https://redwood-internal.app/fin/reconciliations/INV-2027-03-7890.csv. Also created ticket FIN-3249 to track cash/AR impact.
Jenna (Accountant): Thanks — I'll pause revenue recognition for March until AWS confirms. If AWS won't reverse, we need partner to confirm absorption in writing so we can book accordingly.
Sam (Cloud Partnerships): AWS replied (excerpt): "We identified a merchant tag mismatch; credits were applied to the wrong vendor invoice. We're investigating and will issue a corrected invoice or reversal within 3 business days." Copy of AWS reply saved in the support case.
Arjun (Billing Ops): I'll monitor the case and post updates here. If we get a corrected invoice, I'll re-run the month-end revenue reconciliation and update FIN-3249.
Maria (Finance): Awesome — assigning owner: @Arjun. Please escalate to AWS TAM if no update in 48 hrs. (reaction: :eyes:)
Tomas (Sales Ops): If partner needs to provide written confirmation, I'll coordinate legal sign-off.
Jenna (Accountant): One more ask — Arjun, when you get the corrected invoice, please export the line-by-line CSV and put it in FIN-3249 so the ledger entries are auditable.
Arjun (Billing Ops): Will do. Marking this thread as tracked. (reaction: :thumbsup:)
